_doc: #882/#883 the Jev questions every Dagu DAG asks, in ONE place (jev-ask.sh builds the state from key=value args and posts it to the sidecar's /decide/<use>). The uses themselves (threshold, allowed, class, gate) are declared in _shared/jev-gate/jev-gate.json. Jev only suggests: a DAG appends the one-line advice to its alert body when the sidecar has an opinion and otherwise sends exactly the alert it sent before.

abnormal.instructions: A gap of `age_hours` hours without any inbound mail, on weekday `weekday` at hour `hour` UTC, is abnormal for a personal mailbox that normally receives mail every few hours.

action.instructions: Which single remediation, if any, fits the unhealthy or crashed containers listed in `issues`?

criteria.none: Nothing should be done automatically; the issue is transient or needs no action.
criteria.container.restart: Restarting the one named container is a proportionate, reversible fix.
criteria.service.restart: The whole service (all its containers) needs a restart.
criteria.page: A human must look at it; touching it automatically could lose data or access.

action.instructions: A pull-and-up of the containers on VM `vm` exited with code `rc`. What is the best next step?

criteria.retry-once: The failure looks transient (network, registry, lock); one retry is likely to succeed.
criteria.rollback-tag: A bad image or tag was deployed; rolling back to the previous tag is the fix.
criteria.page: The cause is unclear or serious; a human should look.

anomalous.instructions: The daily connection report in `report` shows activity that is anomalous compared with a normal day on these four personal servers (unusual failed logins, sudo events or logins).
